# David Geha - AI Consultant in Lebanon

> David Geha is an independent AI consultant based in Beirut, Lebanon. He offers AI consulting, agentic AI automation and custom AI solutions to marketing agencies, F&B businesses and founders in Lebanon and across the Middle East.

## Who
David Geha is a Civil & Environmental Engineering student at the American University of Beirut (AUB) who runs an AI consultancy for businesses across Lebanon. He audits how a team works, finds the repetitive manual work, and replaces it with agentic AI systems that run on their own. He also designs and builds full products: UI/UX, backend, and web apps.

## Services (AI consulting & AI solutions in Lebanon)
- AI consulting for Lebanese businesses: workflow audit, prioritized automation map, fixed-price scoped plan
- Agentic AI automation: lead-outreach pipelines, competitive research & SEO/GEO pipelines, image-ad generation, daily reporting, back-office workflows
- Custom AI solutions & internal tools: custom CRMs, dashboards, client portals, web apps with AI in the workflow
- AI for marketing agencies & F&B operators in Beirut and across Lebanon

## Stack
Supabase, Vercel, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, GitHub, GPT Image 2.0, plus custom-built CRMs and outreach systems. Clients own the code and the data.

## Process
1. Find the repetitive work (audit)
2. Build the agentic system
3. Automate & scale, and measure the hours saved

## Frequently asked
- What does an AI consultant in Lebanon do? Finds repetitive, manual work inside a business and replaces it with custom agentic AI systems: audit, design, build, handover.
- How much does AI consulting cost in Lebanon? Focused automations are fixed-price projects measured in weeks; larger builds (custom CRM, client app) are scoped after a short audit. Price is agreed before work starts.
- Who does he work with? Mainly marketing agencies and F&B businesses in Beirut and across Lebanon, plus founders; also remote clients across the Middle East.
